summary: Amended the plan so derived data is computed before writeSidecar in assemble/merge paths, while writeSidecar only emits precomputed state artifacts.
Removed the contradictory state-side recommendations/dependencyGraph contract and updated architecture, files-to-modify, and acceptance criteria to emit those as separate JSON artifacts.
Updated the plan so prdsByTaskId is built from matched bundles and passed into scoreRecommendations as well as deriveDependencyGraph.

Reordered sync-integration so US-005 performs state enrichment and incremental propagation before US-006 wires derived artifact emission, and updated the decomposition rationale to require that serial order.
Updated the dependency graph and artifact emission plan so generatedAt/generatedFromCommit come from the Ralph sidecar state instead of overviewData.
Updated the toolbar test reference and PipelineOverview interaction test paths to use src/__tests__/interactions/.
Changed the build-size acceptance criterion to under 512000 bytes and added plans/overview.html as a generated artifact to regenerate via pnpm overview:build and commit.
Replaced commit-message-based downstream diff verification with an in-repo refresh changelog artifact included alongside the updated plan files.
